currency.basis: Historical record: ООО КБ «Кольцо Урала» (Екатеринбург, ОГРН 1026600001955) joined ПАО «Московский кредитный банк» by reorganization; licence annulled 2022-01-01 (merger, not revocation). The archived official site logo (Wayback capture 2021-01-02) represents the last independent brand period through 2021.

identity.basis: Company record КБ "КОЛЬЦО УРАЛА" (metadata URL kubank.ru) matches the Yekaterinburg bank whose official 2021 site header carried this exact lockup (emblem + 'Банк Кольцо Урала' wordmark); the live www.kubank.ru static merger landing keeps the same raster logo.

assessment.independenceRationale: Official site asset (Wayback capture of www.kubank.ru theme logo.svg) is the primary publication; the ЦБ РФ registry independently establishes the lifecycle boundary. Live-site raster logo corroborates continued emblem identity.
uncertainties: No standalone emblem file exists on the archived site; the emblem is proposed as a group-level lossless extraction from the official lockup vector (wordmark excluded per catalog suitability), with the full lockup preserved as source evidence.

variant.basis: Direct archived official SVG (viewBox 0 0 1241 254): yellow #FFB400 emblem (crown + lizard/ring) at left plus black wordmark; the emblem group is self-contained with its own defs/mask (#c/#d).

candidate.detailsJudgement: All emblem contours preserved exactly: crown, head/eye, ring strokes and the small limbs; single flat fill #FFB400; mask behaviour unchanged; transparency preserved.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Emblem fills its natural bounding box, centered in the 54 dp icon area, complete and legible at 24-48 px diagnostics on both themes; no clipping, stretching or added backing (transparent standalone mark policy).
candidate.rationale: First addition from the archived official header lockup: the standalone emblem (crown + lizard/ring, #FFB400) extracted losslessly from the official vector; wordmark excluded per catalog suitability.
candidate.role: standalone bank emblem (lizard biting its tail forming a ring, crowned), left mark of the official header lockup
transforms: group-level lossless extraction of the emblem subtree (defs path #c, mask #d, crown path, emblem group) from the official lockup SVG; no path geometry, fill or alpha changed; wordmark paths removed as accompanying text
viewport changed from the lockup canvas 0 0 1241 254 to the emblem bounds 0 17 236 218 (whole-emblem crop only; no scaling or distortion of the emblem itself)

proposals.reason: First addition: bank record has no icon.svg. Found the archived official lockup vector; its standalone emblem is suitable after lossless group extraction.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original official vector: archived header logo of the bank's own site. The standalone emblem is a lossless group-level extraction of the official lockup (no tracing, no redraw, no recolor); the wordmark is excluded only because catalog marks must not carry accompanying text. Verified visually: complete crown+lizard/ring emblem in #FFB400, correct on white and dark backgrounds.

sources.observation: Wayback capture 2021-01-02 of the official site header logo (CSS .logo background-url): full lockup 1241x254, emblem #FFB400 plus black wordmark; emblem group self-contained with defs/mask.
Live www.kubank.ru serves a static 2022 merger landing with the same emblem as raster (src/images/logo.png); no SVG on the live site. Apex kubank.ru TLS-resets.
ЦБ РФ registry: ООО КБ «Кольцо Урала» joined ПАО «Московский кредитный банк» by reorganization, licence annulled 2022-01-01; establishes the historical record and last brand period (through 2021).
